label: Code Geass
description: Exiled prince Lelouch vi Britannia acquires the power of absolute obedience and wages war to destroy an empire.

vocab.context: Lelouch was born as a prince of the Britannian empire, the son of the king who cast him aside.
Japan, once a free country, was conquered and renamed Area 11 by Britannia.
The war between Britannia and the resistance defines every episode of Code Geass.
The Britannian military deploys Knightmare Frames to suppress uprisings in Area 11.
Zero considers all who uphold Britannia's tyranny to be his enemies.
Lelouch wears a white mask as the masked rebel leader Zero.
Geass allows Lelouch to give any command that the target must obey without question.
C.C. grants Lelouch the power of Geass, changing the course of history.
Zero launches many of his operations under cover of night to avoid detection.
Lelouch's Geass manifests as a glowing symbol in his left eye.
Lelouch questions what it truly means to fight for the people you claim to protect.
Lelouch declares he will destroy and rebuild the world for his sister Nunnally.
Lelouch builds his entire identity as Zero on a foundation of carefully constructed lies.
The Japanese resistance fights to reclaim freedom for their occupied homeland.
The Elevens are treated as second-class citizens stripped of rights by Britannia.
Zero leads a revolution against Britannia under the banner of justice and equality.
The Black Knights' rebellion shakes the foundations of the Britannian empire.
The Britannian royal family is riven with conspiracies for power and succession.
Britannia's philosophy justifies military domination of weaker nations.
Suzaku believes in achieving justice by working within the system rather than destroying it.
Lelouch is a chess genius whose strategies on the battlefield are unmatched.
The Holy Britannian Empire spans much of the world and rules through military supremacy.
Britannian nobles enjoy enormous privilege over the conquered peoples of Area 11.
Zero accepts terrible sacrifices in pursuit of his ultimate goal.
Lelouch swears revenge on his father and the empire that exiled him and crippled his mother.
Lelouch is ultimately alone, unable to share his true identity or goals with those he loves.
Geass lets Lelouch manipulate anyone into following his commands absolutely.
The truth behind Marianne's murder is a secret that drives the entire plot.
Lelouch refuses to accept the fate assigned to him and sets out to forge his own.
Lelouch swears an oath before his childhood friend Suzaku to destroy Britannia.
Lelouch steels his resolve, accepting that he must become a villain for peace to exist.
After the massacre at Narita, many in the Black Knights sink into despair.
The Black Knights' betrayal of Zero is one of the most devastating moments in the series.
Every victory Zero achieves comes at an enormous personal and human cost.
Zero forges uneasy alliances with various factions to challenge Britannian power.
Lelouch's tactical command of the Black Knights earns him legendary status.
The liberation of Japan from Britannian rule is the rallying cry of the resistance.
Britannia's governance of occupied territories relies on brutal suppression of dissent.
Britannia's drive for global hegemony is the root cause of the war in Code Geass.
Lelouch employs deep intrigue, exploiting Britannia's internal politics against itself.
Honorary Britannians are seen as puppets of imperial power by the Japanese resistance.
Charles zi Britannia rules through autocracy, treating his subjects as tools of the state.
Britannia exploits the Sakuradite mines of Area 11 to fuel its military machine.
The humiliation of defeat and exile fuels Lelouch's unending hatred of his father.
The Japanese resistance refuses to yield despite overwhelming Britannian military force.
The Emperor of Britannia reigns over a global empire built on conquest and fear.
Zero Requiem is designed to trigger the moral collapse of the old world order.
Internal purges within the Britannian royal family keep potential rivals in check.
Britannia sends Knightmare Frames to suppress any uprisings in occupied territories.
Zero's public declarations inspire millions across the world to join the resistance.
Lelouch maintains a convincing disguise as a normal student while leading the Black Knights.
The struggle for power between Lelouch and his father is the heart of Code Geass.
Lelouch uses Geass to erase Shirley's memories when they become a dangerous liability.
Zero becomes a symbol of hope for all who suffer under Britannian oppression.
Lelouch's ultimate goal is a peaceful world where Nunnally can be happy.
Lelouch's battle strategy is compared to grandmaster chess by his enemies.
Each victory of the Black Knights brings Lelouch one step closer to his goal.
Charles zi Britannia is the ruthless emperor Lelouch has sworn to destroy.
Suzaku serves as a Knight of the Round, an elite warrior in the Britannian military.
Zero is hailed as a hero by the oppressed peoples fighting against Britannia.
Lelouch accepts his role as the villain so the world can direct its hatred at him.
The Britannian legal system labels all acts of resistance as crimes against the empire.
Knightmare Frames are the primary weapons deployed in the battles of Code Geass.
The streets of Area 11 become a battlefield as Zero's rebellion escalates.
The survival of the Japanese people is at stake as Britannia tightens its grip.
Suzaku carries out his military mission even when it conflicts with his personal values.
C.C. and Lelouch form a contract that grants him Geass in exchange for a price.

meanings.en: Geass — supernatural power of absolute obedience
meanings.pt-BR: Geass — poder sobrenatural de obediência absoluta
meanings.es: Geass — poder sobrenatural de obediencia absoluta

vocab.context: C.C. grants Lelouch the Geass, a power that forces anyone he looks at to follow his commands.
Lelouch dons a mask and cape to become Zero, the symbol of the revolution.
Zero founds the Black Knights as the armed force of the resistance against Britannia.
Britannia is the dominant empire that has conquered Japan and many other nations.

vocab.reading: めいよぶりたにあじん

meanings.en: Honorary Britannian — conquered peoples who renounce their heritage
meanings.pt-BR: Britânico Honorário — povos conquistados que renunciam sua herança
meanings.es: Británico Honorario — pueblos conquistados que renuncian su herencia

vocab.context: Japanese people can become Honorary Britannians by renouncing their identity, which many see as betrayal.

meanings.pt-BR: Knightmare Frame — mecha de combate humanóide
meanings.es: Knightmare Frame — meca de combate humanoide

vocab.context: Knightmare Frames are the heavily armed mobile suits that dominate the battlefields of Code Geass.
Lelouch vi Britannia is the exiled prince who becomes Zero and leads the revolution.

meanings.pt-BR: Suzaku — piloto japonês a serviço de Britânia
meanings.es: Suzaku — piloto japonés al servicio de Britannia

vocab.context: Suzaku Kururugi is Lelouch's childhood friend who fights for Britannia from within the system.

meanings.en: C.C. — immortal witch who grants Geass
meanings.pt-BR: C.C. — bruxa imortal que concede o Geass
meanings.es: C.C. — bruja inmortal que otorga el Geass

vocab.context: C.C. is the mysterious immortal who makes a contract with Lelouch and grants him the power of Geass.
Lelouch's Geass is described as the power of absolute obedience — no one can resist his commands.

vocab.reading: しんせいぶりたにあていこく
vocab.context: The Holy Britannian Empire is the all-powerful antagonist nation in Code Geass, claiming divine right to rule.
Kururugi Suzaku is the son of Japan's last prime minister and Lelouch's most trusted rival.

vocab.surface: ルルーシュ・ヴィ・ブリタニア
vocab.reading: るるーしゅ・ヴぃ・ぶりたにあ

meanings.en: Lelouch vi Britannia — full royal name
meanings.pt-BR: Lelouch vi Britannia — nome real completo
meanings.es: Lelouch vi Britannia — nombre real completo

vocab.context: Lelouch vi Britannia is the seventeenth prince of Britannia, exiled and presumed dead.
Britannia renames conquered Japan as Area 11, stripping it of its national identity.

vocab.reading: にほんかいほうせんせん
vocab.context: The Japan Liberation Front is a resistance faction that fights for Japanese independence before being eclipsed by the Black Knights.

meanings.pt-BR: Réquiem do Zero — plano final de Lelouch
meanings.es: Réquiem de Cero — plan final de Lelouch

vocab.context: Zero Requiem is the secret plan Lelouch and Suzaku devise to end the cycle of hatred.

meanings.pt-BR: Lancelot — Knightmare Frame de elite de Suzaku
meanings.es: Lancelot — Knightmare Frame de élite de Suzaku

vocab.context: The Lancelot is Suzaku's advanced white Knightmare Frame, far superior to standard models.

meanings.en: Sakuradite — rare mineral resource found in Japan
meanings.pt-BR: Sakuradite — mineral raro encontrado no Japão
meanings.es: Sakuradite — mineral raro encontrado en Japón

vocab.context: Sakuradite is the rare superconductor mineral that makes Japan strategically vital to Britannia.
Kishidan'in fight loyally under Zero's command in the battle against Britannia.

meanings.en: Kallen — ace pilot of the Black Knights
meanings.pt-BR: Kallen — piloto ás dos Cavaleiros Negros
meanings.es: Kallen — piloto as de los Caballeros Negros

vocab.context: Kallen Stadtfeld is the Black Knights' most skilled Knightmare pilot and Zero's most devoted ally.
Nunnally is blind and wheelchair-bound; Lelouch's desire to protect her drives all his actions.

meanings.en: Charles — Emperor of Britannia, Lelouch's father
meanings.pt-BR: Charles — Imperador de Britânia, pai de Lelouch
meanings.es: Charles — Emperador de Britannia, padre de Lelouch

vocab.context: Charles zi Britannia discarded Lelouch and Nunnally and is the ultimate antagonist of the series.

meanings.en: Euphemia — Britannian princess who declares the Special Administrative Zone
meanings.pt-BR: Eufêmia — princesa britânica que declara a Zona Administrativa Especial
meanings.es: Euphemia — princesa británica que declara la Zona Administrativa Especial

vocab.context: Princess Euphemia's tragic death at the Narita massacre becomes the turning point of the first season.

vocab.reading: さくらだいとこうざん
vocab.context: Control of Japan's Sakuradite mines is key to Britannia's military and technological dominance.
Lelouch is branded a rebel and traitor by Britannia, yet a liberator by the people he leads.
Lelouch is widely regarded as a military genius and brilliant strategist by allies and enemies alike.
Britannia maintains order through fear and military force rather than consent.
The geopolitical balance of power shifts dramatically each time Zero achieves a major victory.
C.C. is an immortal who has lived for centuries, cursed to outlive everyone she meets.
The Sword of Akasha and the collective unconscious threaten the very existence of individual souls.
Several key plot turns in Code Geass hinge on assassination attempts against powerful figures.
Britannia's occupation of Japan strips the country of its name, culture, and rights.
